Bodies are pretty simple. You have a glycogen "tank" distributed between your muscles and liver. The emptier that tank is the hungrier you will feel.

Evolution invented this cool system called the glycogen reserve (aka fat). When your glycogen tank is getting low, your body starts converting your fat into glycogen to replenish that tank and prevent death. Glycogen tank sizes vary, but most people can store around 2000 calories' worth of glycogen in their main tanks (liver + muscles). Not coincidentally this is why the fabled marathon "wall" is around 20 miles in. 100 calories per mile times 20 miles = 2000 calories. Once your stores are empty, your body goes into full sugar protection mode so your vital systems don't stop and you involuntarily stop running (or drastically slow down). If you've never felt that mechanism kick in, well, it sucks because you're bonking your race but it's definitely a unique experience.

If you never exercise, then you are totally at the mercy of your body's basal metabolic rate which is incredibly hard to measure, so it's a guessing game. Your lack of muscle mass means you have fewer muscle cells to store glyogen, thus reducing the size of your glycogen tank. And, likely, your glycogen tank is perpetually full or very close to full. Guess what happens when you eat even a single digestible calorie over your glycogen tank capacity, your body turns it into fat.

Fortunately, our bodies have this great way of letting us know how full or empty our glycogen tank is: it's called hunger. If you're feeling it, your glycogen tanks are starting to empty. In fats who are always keeping it close to full, they'll start to feel hungry at, say, 80%. For shitlords, especially athletes, our tanks are constantly being almost depleted and then full again. Our bodies adapt to this by only raising the hunger alarm when the tank is closer to half empty, or even lower.

This means that when a shitlord overeats, we're more likely to stay satiated for longer. It will take shitlord's body perhaps a full day to drain the glycogen tanks with BMR alone, so shitlord can eat a big meal and feel fine for an entire day later.
